### What to Have Ready When Requesting a Quote

To get an accurate and fast quote without multiple site visits, prepare these details for the electrician:

1. **Power Supply:** Do you know if your home is **single-phase** or **three-phase** power? (Check your main switchboard for 1 main breaker vs. 3 side-by-side main breakers).[[1]](https://cable-co.com.au/services/ev-charging)
2. **Charger Model:** Do you already own the charger (e.g., Tesla Wall Connector, Wallbox, Zappi), or do you need the electrician to supply and recommend one?[[1]](https://sydneyevchargers.com.au/locations/ev-charger-installation-baulkham-hills/)
3. **Switchboard Distance:** Roughly how far is your parking spot/garage from your main switchboard (e.g., adjacent wall vs. trenching across the driveway/house)?
4. **Vehicle Type:** What EV model are you charging?[[1]](https://cable-co.com.au/services/ev-charging)

To help narrow this down:

- Do you already have a **specific EV charger** bought or in mind?
- Is your home on a **single-phase** or **three-phase** supply?
